items.title: 〈環宇法說〉光通訊市場持續供不應求 美禁中國光收發器有利後市營運
items.title_en: Universal Optoelectronics Says Optical Communications Market Remains Short of Supply; US Ban on Chinese Optical Transceivers Benefits Future Operations
paras: 環宇 - KY(4991-TW) 今 (5) 日舉行法說會，受惠於 AI 資料中心，帶動公司在光電晶圓代工與自有品牌光電元件 (AOC) 需求強勁，訂單能見度可看到今 (2026) 年年底，全年出貨展望樂觀。此外，針對傳聞美國川普即將禁止進口新型的中國製光收發器，環宇 - KY 總執行長兼總裁安寶信也指出，若能禁止中國進口，對於環宇 - KY 未來營運將有加分效果。
環宇 - KY 今日舉行線上法說會，也公告第 2 季財報，環宇 - KY 第 2 季營收為 7.7 億元、季增 7.8%、年增 57.2%；單季毛利率為 43.3%、季減 11.2 個百分比、年減 5.5 個百分比；稅後純益為 1.1 億元、季減 43.8%、年增達 672%，單季 EPS 為 0.92 元。
安寶信表示，展望第 3 季除營收持續成長外，也希望公司毛利率預估維持在 44%-48%，目前營業費用約介於 750 萬至 850 萬美元，在手訂單目前可看到年底，但受到磷化銦 (InP) 基板欠缺影響，連帶使產能受到限制，不過目前公司備料狀況觀察，到今年年底前沒有問題，明年會持續連繫其他國家供應商以解決原料問題。
會中也有法人提問，環宇 - KY 第 2 季毛利率掉到 43.3%、減少 12.2% 原因。安寶信表示，主要是產品組合變化及 AOC 的產量下降，第 2 季產品占比觀察，射頻晶圓代工約 23%，光電晶圓代工約 10%，AOC61%，其他 6%，上半年稅後純益為 3 億元，較去年同期由虧轉盈，上半年 EPS 為 2.58 元。
此外，針對外電報載，川普即將禁止中國製造的資料中心光收發模組進入美國，引發中國廠商中際旭創受影響。安寶信也對此回應，因環宇 - KY 生產地點就在美國，若美系客戶要向外採購下，對環宇 - KY 來說有望成為一大契機及後市營運。
paras_en: Universal Optoelectronics (KY) (4991‑TW) held its earnings briefing today (the 5th). Benefiting from AI data centers, the company sees strong demand for its photonic wafer foundry services and its own‑brand optoelectronic components (AOC), with order visibility extending to the end of 2026 and an optimistic full‑year shipment outlook. In response to rumors that the United States under President Trump will soon ban imports of new Chinese‑made optical transceivers, CEO and President An Baoxin noted that such a ban would be a plus for Universal’s future operations.

Universal conducted an online briefing today and also released its Q2 financial results. Q2 revenue was NT$770 million, up 7.8% quarter‑over‑quarter and 57.2% year‑over‑year. The quarterly gross margin was 43.3%, down 11.2 percentage points QoQ and 5.5 points YoY. Net profit after tax was NT$110 million, down 43.8% QoQ but up 672% YoY, with earnings per share of NT$0.92 for the quarter.

An said that for Q3, besides continued revenue growth, the company expects gross margins to stay in the 44%‑48% range. Operating expenses are currently about US$7.5‑8.5 million. Existing orders can be seen through year‑end, but a shortage of indium phosphide (InP) substrates is constraining capacity. However, the company’s material inventory looks sufficient through the end of this year, and it will keep contacting suppliers in other countries next year to resolve the raw‑material issue.

During the session, an institutional investor asked why Q2 gross margin fell to 43.3%, a 12.2‑point decline. An explained that the drop was mainly due to a shift in product mix and a reduction in AOC production. In Q2, product composition was roughly: RF wafer foundry 23%, photonic wafer foundry 10%, AOC 61%, and other 6%. For the first half of the year, net profit after tax was NT$300 million, turning a loss into a profit year‑over‑year, and H1 EPS was NT$2.58.

Regarding reports that the Trump administration will ban Chinese‑made data‑center optical transceiver modules from entering the United States, which could affect Chinese supplier Zhongji Xuchuang, An responded that Universal’s production sites are located in the U.S. If American customers need to source abroad, this could become a major opportunity for Universal’s future operations.

items.title: AI浪潮驅動記憶體超級周期 華爾街多家主要機構看好SK海力士
items.title_en: AI Drives Memory Super Cycle, Wall Street Institutions are Bullish on SK Hynix
paras: 隨著全球人工智慧 (AI) 基礎建設持續擴張，半導體記憶體產業正迎來結構性的轉型。亞洲股市周三 (5 日) 在經歷波動後強勢反彈，南韓 KOSPI 指數收盤漲幅達 3.76%，其中全球記憶體大廠 SK 海力士表現尤為顯著，股價大漲 5.77%。
此波漲勢背後，主要受到多間華爾街金融機構同步啟動對 SK 海力士 (SKHY-US) ADR 的研究覆蓋，並一致給予正面評等所帶動。
根據市場最新資訊，包含美國銀行、瑞銀與摩根大通在內的至少六家金融機構，近期針對 SK 海力士發布首份分析報告，集體對該標的表達「買入」或「增持」立場。
美國銀行在研究報告中分析指出，由於美國科技企業對高端記憶體晶片的訂單保持旺盛，且 SK 海力士在該領域具備領先的龍頭地位，配合全球 AI 基礎建設投入的規模擴容，預期公司業績將迎來「記憶體超級周期」，並認為目前股價存在明顯低估現象。
瑞銀分析師 Nicolas Gaudois 延續至 2028 年。Gaudois 認為，目前的市場估值尚未充分反映出產業結構性獲利上行、自由現金流的大幅改善，以及公司持續加碼的股東回報政策。
摩根大通對記憶體產業前景同樣持樂觀看法，指出雲端服務提供者 (CSP) 及 AI 模型實驗室的收入動能正持續增強，顯示 AI 資本支出趨勢的投資回報率正在改善。
儘管考慮到機會成本，該行將目標本益比 (P/E Multiple) 由 8 倍下調至 7 倍，並將目標價由 300 萬韓元修正至 275 萬韓元，但仍強調以 12 個月視角來看，風險報酬依然有利，並將近期的股價調整視為逢低佈局 (加碼) 的機會。
在技術佈局方面，SK 海力士透過制定產業標準鞏固其技術領先地位。該公司與快閃記憶體大廠 SanDisk(SNDK-US) 聯手發布了「高頻寬快閃記憶體 (High-Bandwidth Flash, HBF)」的首套標準規範。此產品最高支持 16 層堆疊，使單顆晶片的存儲容量可達 512GB。
此 HBF 規格標準化聯盟於今年 2 月由雙方牽頭成立，歷經 6 個月的研發完成制定。為了推動技術普及，該規範已透過全球最大的開放數據中心技術合作組織 OCP(開放計算項目) 對外公開，供全產業免費使用。
市場分析指出，隨著 HBF 標準的確立，不僅有助於提升數據中心的運算效率，也將進一步強化 SK 海力士在高端存儲賽道的競爭壁壘。
paras_en: As the global artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure continues to expand, the semiconductor memory industry is undergoing a structural transformation. Asian stocks rebounded strongly on Wednesday, with the South Korean KOSPI index rising 3.76% and SK Hynix, a leading memory manufacturer, surging 5.77%.

This surge is driven by multiple Wall Street financial institutions initiating research coverage on SK Hynix (SKHY-US) ADR and giving it a positive rating. At least six financial institutions, including Bank of America, UBS, and JPMorgan, have released their first analysis reports on SK Hynix, collectively giving it a 'buy' or 'outperform' rating.

According to market information, Bank of America's research report states that due to strong demand from US tech companies for high-end memory chips, and SK Hynix's leading position in this field, the company's performance is expected to enter a 'memory super cycle' as global AI infrastructure investment expands. The report also believes that the current stock price is significantly undervalued.

UBS analyst Nicolas Gaudois expects the trend to continue until 2028, stating that the current market valuation does not fully reflect the industry's structural profit growth, significant improvement in free cash flow, and the company's increasing shareholder return policy.

JPMorgan is also optimistic about the memory industry's prospects, citing the growing revenue momentum of cloud service providers (CSPs) and AI model labs, which indicates an improving return on investment for AI capital expenditures. Although the bank has lowered its target P/E multiple from 8 to 7 and its target price from 3 million Korean won to 2.75 million Korean won, it still believes that the risk-reward ratio is favorable over a 12-month period and views the recent price adjustment as a buying opportunity.

In terms of technical layout, SK Hynix has consolidated its technical leadership by establishing industry standards. The company has collaborated with SanDisk (SNDK-US) to release the first standard specification for 'High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF)' memory, which supports up to 16 layers of stacking and a single chip storage capacity of 512GB.

The HBF standardization alliance, established in February, has completed the development of the specification in six months. To promote the technology, the specification has been made public through the Open Compute Project (OCP), the largest open data center technology cooperation organization, for the entire industry to use free of charge. Market analysis suggests that the establishment of the HBF standard will not only improve data center computing efficiency but also further strengthen SK Hynix's competitive barriers in the high-end storage market.

items.title: 2027科技預算1823億元史上最高 國科會：加碼AI算力、帶動中小微企業轉型AI化
items.title_en: Taiwan's 2027 Budget for Science and Technology Reaches NT$182.3 Billion, Highest in History
paras: 明 (2027) 年度中央總預算案已籌編完成，國科會主委吳誠文今 (5) 日表示，明年科技預算再創新高，達新台幣 1,823 億元，較今 (2026) 年成長約 9.47%，重點包括加碼投入主權 AI 算力與基礎建設，打造智慧國家 2.0，並藉由科技產業優勢帶動中小微企業轉型與 AI 化。
吳誠文表示，台灣雖然已經具有半導體與 AI 硬體產業的深厚實力，然而強敵環伺不能掉以輕心，必須持續不斷提升科技研發實力及國際競爭力。在全球地緣政治局勢與 AI 科技競合之際，台灣除了強化半導體與 AI 產業優勢以鞏固科技戰略地位及經濟繁榮之外，也正面臨產業結構轉型的關鍵階段，應該要藉科技產業優勢帶動社會各行各業繁榮。
吳誠文說明，雖然今 (2026) 年的中央總預算還在立法院討論，但行政院已經完成了明年總預算的規劃，明年科技預算將創新高來到 1,823 億元，相較於今年成長約 9.47%，其中最重要的是主權 AI 算力與基礎建設加碼投入，打造智慧國家 2.0，並藉科技產業優勢帶動中小微企業轉型與 AI 化，促進社會各行業全面繁榮。
吳誠文強調，明年行政院科技預算，首先要保障基礎學術研究穩定成長，並重點投入全球競逐的高效能運算、量子科技、智慧機器人、矽光子與光通訊、主權 AI 等「AI 新十大建設」關鍵科技及「五大信賴產業」關鍵科技。
吳誠文指出，例如：一、大南方新矽谷 84 億，加速建構南台灣 AI 產業生態系；二、 晶創台灣 207 億，落實「優勢延續、國際拓展、應用創新、永續調適」四大半導體政策支柱與產業技術布局；三、次世代通訊 4 億，掌握低軌通訊衛星產業發展契機，建構 6G 通訊產業優勢；四、智慧機器人 22 億，推動智慧機器人研發與產業生態系建構。
五、太空計畫三期 69 億，發展低軌通訊衛星與前瞻遙測衛星系統，建構國際太空產業合作契機；六、海洋科技方案 22 億，發展科技以推動海域安全科技化、海洋產業智慧化、海洋文化生活化；七、淨零科技 108 億，發展淨零與碳循環科技，推動實際場域驗證及社區實作以加速產業化；高齡科技 16 億元，推動高齡科技研發、應用服務系統開發、場域驗證、產業化等。
吳誠文指出，明年起行政院也將整合中央各部會能量推動「智慧國家 2.0」計畫，與地方政府合作把 AI 科技轉化為社會各行各業 AI 化的應用，進一步讓智慧化的中小微企業蓬勃發展，邁向全民智慧生活圈。
paras_en: The 2027 central government budget has been completed, and National Science Council (NSC) Chairman Wu Ching-wen announced on May 5 that the budget for science and technology will reach a new high of NT$182.3 billion, a 9.47% increase from last year. The focus will be on investing in sovereign AI computing power and infrastructure, creating a smart nation 2.0, and using technology industry advantages to drive the transformation and AI of small and medium-sized enterprises.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that although Taiwan has a deep foundation in semiconductor and AI hardware industries, it cannot be complacent with the strong competition surrounding it. It must continue to improve its technological research and development capabilities and international competitiveness. In the context of global geopolitics and AI technology competition, Taiwan not only needs to strengthen its semiconductor and AI industry advantages to consolidate its technological strategic position and economic prosperity, but also faces a critical stage of industrial structural transformation.

Wu Ching-wen explained that although the 2026 central government budget is still being discussed in the Legislative Yuan, the Executive Yuan has completed the planning for next year's budget. Next year's science and technology budget will reach a new high of NT$182.3 billion, a 9.47% increase from this year. The most important thing is to invest in sovereign AI computing power and infrastructure, create a smart nation 2.0, and use technology industry advantages to drive the transformation and AI of small and medium-sized enterprises, promoting the overall prosperity of various industries.

Wu Ching-wen emphasized that next year's Executive Yuan science and technology budget will first ensure the stable growth of basic academic research and focus on investing in key technologies such as high-performance computing, quantum technology, intelligent robots, silicon photonics and optical communication, and sovereign AI. The "AI New Ten Major Construction" and "Five Major Trust Industries" key technologies will also be prioritized.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that, for example, one is the South Taiwan AI Industry Ecosystem Construction Project, which will invest NT$84 billion to accelerate the construction of the AI industry ecosystem in southern Taiwan. Two is the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) project, which will invest NT$207 billion to implement the "Continuation of Advantage, International Expansion, Innovation, and Sustainable Adaptation" four-pillar semiconductor policy and industry technology layout.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that, for example, one is the Next-Generation Communication Project, which will invest NT$4 billion to grasp the opportunity of low-orbit communication satellite industry development, build a 6G communication industry advantage. Two is the Intelligent Robot Project, which will invest NT$22 billion to promote the development of intelligent robots and the construction of the robot industry ecosystem.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that, for example, one is the Space Plan Phase 3, which will invest NT$69 billion to develop low-orbit communication satellites and advanced remote sensing satellite systems, build international space industry cooperation opportunities. Two is the Ocean Technology Scheme, which will invest NT$22 billion to develop technology to promote ocean security, ocean industry intelligence, and ocean cultural living. Three is the Zero-Carbon Technology Project, which will invest NT$108 billion to develop zero-carbon and carbon cycle technologies, promote practical field verification and community implementation to accelerate industrialization.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that, for example, one is the Aging Technology Project, which will invest NT$16 billion to promote aging technology research and development, application service system development, field verification, and industrialization.

items.title: 88萬家企業納入集體訴訟！Google恐面臨50億英鎊天價求償
items.title_en: 88 Million Businesses Eligible for Collective Lawsuit! Google Faces £5 Billion Compensation Claim
paras: Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下 Google 試圖阻止英國一宗搜尋廣告集體訴訟，但遭法院駁回。英國競爭上訴法庭 (Competition Appeal Tribunal) 周三 (5 日) 裁定，這起代表數十萬家英國企業提出的訴訟符合資格，得以進入後續審理程序。
訴訟指控 Google 利用其在行動作業系統、應用程式分發及搜尋廣告市場的主導地位，向購買網路廣告的企業收取過高費用，涉嫌濫用市場優勢。
擔任集體訴訟代表人的競爭法學者 Or Brook，其律師團隊估計，約有 88 萬家英國企業符合資格，求償金額最高可能達 50 億英鎊 (約 67 億美元)。
法庭在判決中表示，這項集體訴訟符合受理條件。符合資格的英國企業將自動被納入原告群體，除非主動選擇退出。這種「選擇退出制」意味受影響企業無須逐一登記，即可成為訴訟的一部分。
不過，法庭此次裁定僅代表案件可以繼續推進，之後仍須就 Google 是否違反競爭法及原告是否確實蒙受損失進行實體審理，並不代表 Google 已被認定違法。Google 發言人尚未回應置評要求。
paras_en: Alphabet's (GOOGL-US) Google has attempted to block a collective lawsuit in the UK over search advertising, but the court has rejected its bid. The UK Competition Appeal Tribunal (CAT) ruled on Wednesday (5th) that the lawsuit, which represents tens of thousands of UK businesses, is eligible to proceed to the next stage of the trial.

The lawsuit alleges that Google has abused its dominance in the mobile operating system, app distribution, and search advertising markets by charging excessive fees to businesses that purchase online ads.

Or Brook, a competition law expert representing the collective lawsuit, estimates that around 880,000 UK businesses are eligible to participate, with a potential compensation claim of up to £5 billion (approximately $6.7 billion).

The court ruled that the collective lawsuit meets the conditions for acceptance. Eligible UK businesses will automatically be included in the plaintiff group, unless they actively choose to opt out. This 'opt-out' mechanism means that affected businesses do not need to register individually to become part of the lawsuit.

However, the court's ruling only allows the case to proceed, and a full trial will still be needed to determine whether Google has breached competition law and whether the plaintiffs have suffered losses. Google has not yet responded to a request for comment.

items.title: 高盛力挺韓股 重申KOSPI目標價12000 點 看好AI與記憶體
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Backs South Korean Stocks, Reiterates KOSPI Target Price of 12,000
paras: 受人工智慧 (AI) 類股回調影響，南韓 KOSPI 指數在 7 月份一度重挫超過 22%，頻繁觸發暫停交易的熔斷機制。然而，高盛依舊堅定維持 KOSPI 指數 12,000 點的目標價，暗示市場仍有約 80% 至 90% 的上漲空間。
高盛亞太區首席股票策略師 Tim Moe 指出，其對南韓市場的信心源於「更強且更長」的盈利周期。高盛認為，目前的市場定價並未反映出記憶體晶片可能持續至 2030 年的嚴重短缺。隨著 AI 運算需求加速，占 KOSPI 權重超過 50% 的半導體產業 (如三星電子與 SK 海力士) 將成為全球盈利引擎。
根據高盛預測，韓股今年的盈餘將增長 32%，明年則預計增長 35%。目前韓股交易價格僅為預期盈餘的 5.1 倍，較歷史常態低了兩個標準差；12,000 點的目標價僅相當於 2028 年預期盈餘的 8 倍本益比。
高盛分析，近期韓股的暴跌主因是零售投資者的槓桿操作崩潰。南韓槓桿 ETF 資產管理規模從 6 月的高峰 530 億美元一度腰斬至 140 億美元，融資貸款餘額也大幅回落。隨著散戶強制平倉與監管機構收緊槓桿規則，市場倉位已變得「乾淨許多」，這為未來的反彈墊定了基礎。
除了半導體，高盛也看好國防工業作為韓股的第二支柱。對於投資者而言，在美上市的 EWY 高度集中於三星與 SK 海力士 (合計占比達 54.74%)，最能體現高盛的晶片策略。而 FLKR 則較為多元，涵蓋了國防、航太、金融及生醫領域，反映了更廣泛的南韓工業實力。
高盛強調，儘管短期波動劇烈，只要三星與 SK 海力士的盈利能兌現預期，韓股在市場情緒平復後將重回上漲軌道。
paras_en: South Korea's KOSPI index plummeted over 22% in July, triggering frequent trading halts, due to a downturn in artificial intelligence (AI) stocks. However, Goldman Sachs remains confident in its target price of 12,000 for the KOSPI index, suggesting there is still around 80% to 90% of upside potential.

Goldman Sachs' Asia Pacific chief equity strategist Tim Moe attributed the firm's confidence in the South Korean market to 'stronger and longer' profit cycles. Goldman Sachs believes that the current market pricing does not reflect the severe shortage of memory chips, which could persist until 2030. As AI computing demand accelerates, the semiconductor industry, which accounts for over 50% of the KOSPI's weight (including Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix), will become the global profit engine.

According to Goldman Sachs' forecast, South Korean earnings will grow 32% this year and 35% next year. The current trading price of Korean stocks is only 5.1 times the expected earnings, which is two standard deviations lower than the historical average; the target price of 12,000 is equivalent to an 8 times price-to-earnings ratio in 2028.

Goldman Sachs attributed the recent sharp decline in Korean stocks to the collapse of retail investors' leveraged trades. South Korean leveraged ETF assets plummeted from a peak of $53 billion in June to $14 billion, while loan balances also declined sharply. As individual investors were forced to close their positions and regulatory bodies tightened leveraged rules, market positions have become 'cleaner', laying the groundwork for a potential rebound.

In addition to semiconductors, Goldman Sachs also sees defense industries as a second pillar for Korean stocks. For investors, the EWY ETF, which is listed in the US, is highly concentrated in Samsung and SK Hynix (combined weighting of 54.74%), reflecting Goldman Sachs' chip strategy. The FLKR ETF, on the other hand, is more diversified, covering defense, aerospace, finance, and biotech sectors, reflecting a broader range of South Korean industrial capabilities.
Goldman Sachs emphasized that despite short-term volatility, as long as Samsung and SK Hynix's earnings meet expectations, Korean stocks will return to an uptrend once market sentiment stabilizes.

items.title: 〈財報〉Uber上季業績無驚喜、本季展望平淡 盤前股價下挫
items.title_en: Uber's Q2 Earnings Disappoint, Q3 Outlook Unimpressive, Shares Fall
paras: Uber Technologies(UBER-US) 周三 (5 日) 於美股盤前公布 2026 會計年度第二季 (截至 6/30) 財報，受惠世界盃帶動叫車需求，總預訂金額優於華爾街預期，但營收僅大致符合預估，第三季 (本季) 獲利與預訂金額展望也未能帶來驚喜，加上巴西市場競爭升溫拖累行程量成長，盤前股價一度下跌約 3.5%。
截稿前，Uber(UBER-US) 周三盤前股價下跌 2.76%，每股暫報 70.00 美元。
Uber 第二季營收年增 12% 至 141.9 億美元，略低於 LSEG 統計分析師預估的 142.4 億美元；調整後每股盈餘為 0.81 美元，高於去年同期的 0.63 美元，也略優於 FactSet 預估的 0.80 美元。
衡量叫車與外送平台整體交易規模的總預訂金額年增 24% 至 580.2 億美元，高於華爾街預估的約 570.6 億至 572.3 億美元。Uber 表示，各地區及各項服務需求普遍增長，世界盃賽事相關旅遊活動尤其強勁，賽事期間有超過 800 萬名遊客在主辦城市使用 Uber。

世界盃需求撐業績 巴西競爭拖累行程量

Uber 第二季叫車與外送行程總量年增 18% 至 38.7 億趟，略低於分析師預估的 39 億趟。該公司表示，行程量增速放緩「完全可歸因於巴西」，該國是 Uber 全球交易量最大的市場，但近期競爭明顯加劇。
包括中國叫車平台滴滴全球 (Didi Global) 及外送巨頭美團在內的業者持續加碼巴西市場，競相爭取當地外送員及消費者，迫使 Uber 投入更多資源維持市占。公司第二季營業支出因此年增約 10%，行銷、研發及行政成本均有所增加。
不過，Uber 表示，過去一年新增的首次使用者人數，創下近五年任何同期最高紀錄。執行長 Dara Khosrowshahi 指出，新使用者持續增加，既有客戶的使用頻率也有所提升，公司正從穩健的業務基礎出發，擴大跨平台策略。
Uber 預估第三季總預訂金額介於 582.5 億至 602.5 億美元，中間值為 592.5 億美元，略低於華爾街預估的約 592.1 億至 593.3 億美元。公司預估調整後每股盈餘為 0.84 至 0.88 美元，中間值 0.86 美元，同樣低於 LSEG 統計的 0.89 美元預期。
Uber 警告，匯率因素預計將使第三季總預訂金額的年增率減少約 1 個百分點，扭轉過去四季匯率帶來的正面助益。由於核心業務展望僅大致符合預期，市場對 Uber 能否在自駕計程車時代維持成長的疑慮仍未消散。

砸逾百億美元押注 Robotaxi 倫敦服務仍配安全駕駛

Uber 重申，未來數年將投入超過 100 億美元發展自動駕駛車輛，但未公布具體投資時程。公司也在財報公布前宣布，將於未來數周與英國新創公司 Wayve Technologies 在倫敦推出 Robotaxi 服務，進度可望領先百度 (BIDU-US)(09888-HK) 與 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 旗下 Waymo 原定的當地部署計畫。
不過，Wayve 車輛初期仍會配置安全駕駛員，原因是雙方將先以一般私人出租車執照營運；若要提供真正無人駕駛服務，仍須取得額外監管批准。
Uber 去年密集宣布多項自駕車合作案，但管理層坦言，多數合作可能需要數年才能產生實質收益。與此同時，Waymo 正透過自有 App 將無人車服務擴展至更多美國城市，而非完全依賴 Uber 平台，也使部分投資人質疑 Uber 未來在 Robotaxi 產業鏈中的地位。
此外，Uber 上月宣布以 148 億美元收購 Delivery Hero，計畫以現有流動資金及舉債支付。大型收購案加上超過 100 億美元的自駕車投資承諾，使公司的資本配置成為市場關注焦點。Uber 股價在財報公布前今年已累計下跌約 12%，財報出爐後盤前跌幅一度擴大至 3.5%。
paras_en: Uber Technologies (UBER-US) reported its Q2 2026 earnings on Wednesday, benefiting from the World Cup's increased demand for ride-hailing services. Despite beating Wall Street's expectations for total bookings, revenue only met estimates, and the company's Q3 earnings and bookings outlook failed to impress. Additionally, the increasing competition in the Brazilian market, where Uber is the largest player, dragged down the growth in ride volume.
As of the deadline, Uber's (UBER-US) stock price fell 2.76% on Wednesday, trading at $70.00 per share.

Uber's Q2 revenue grew 12% year-over-year to $14.19 billion, slightly below the estimate of $14.24 billion from LSEG. Adjusted earnings per share were $0.81, higher than the $0.63 in the same period last year and slightly above FactSet's estimate of $0.80.

Total bookings, a measure of the company's overall transaction volume, grew 24% year-over-year to $58.02 billion, exceeding Wall Street's estimate of $57.06 billion to $57.23 billion. Uber stated that demand for its services was growing across regions and services, with World Cup-related travel activities being particularly strong, with over 8 million users in host cities using Uber during the event.
World Cup demand boosted earnings, but Brazilian competition hurt ride volume

Uber's Q2 ride volume grew 18% year-over-year to 3.87 billion trips, slightly below analysts' estimates of 3.9 billion trips. The company attributed the slowdown in growth to Brazil, which is Uber's largest market, but has seen increasing competition from companies like Didi Global (Didi Global) and Meituan (Meituan) in recent months.

Uber's operating expenses grew 10% year-over-year, with increased marketing, research and development, and administrative costs. However, the company stated that it had added a record number of new users in the past year, with CEO Dara Khosrowshahi saying that new users were continuing to increase, and existing users were using the service more frequently.

Uber forecast Q3 total bookings to be between $58.25 billion and $60.25 billion, with a midpoint of $59.25 billion, slightly below Wall Street's estimate of $59.21 billion to $59.33 billion. The company also forecast adjusted earnings per share to be between $0.84 and $0.88, with a midpoint of $0.86, slightly below LSEG's estimate of $0.89.

Uber warned that exchange rates would reduce its Q3 total bookings growth rate by about 1 percentage point, reversing the positive impact of exchange rates in the previous four quarters. The company's lackluster Q3 outlook has left investors concerned about its ability to maintain growth in the self-driving car era.

Uber reaffirmed its commitment to investing over $10 billion in autonomous vehicles over the next few years, but did not provide a specific timeline for its investments. The company also announced that it would be launching a Robotaxi service in London with Wayve Technologies, a UK-based startup, in the coming weeks, potentially ahead of Waymo's planned deployment in the city.

However, the initial Wayve vehicles will still be equipped with safety drivers, as the company plans to operate under a private hire license, and will need additional regulatory approvals to offer fully autonomous services.

Uber's management acknowledged that many of its self-driving partnerships may take years to generate tangible returns, while Waymo is expanding its autonomous services through its own app in more US cities, raising questions about Uber's role in the Robotaxi industry.

Uber also announced its plan to acquire Delivery Hero for $14.8 billion last month, which will be paid for with existing cash and debt. The large acquisition, combined with its over $10 billion commitment to self-driving cars, has raised concerns about the company's capital allocation. Uber's stock price has fallen about 12% this year, and fell as much as 3.5% after the earnings report.

items.title: Fed還能只盯著通膨？美國7月小非農僅增4.4萬人 增幅創半年最低
items.title_en: US July Small Business Jobs Growth Slows to 44,000, Lowest in Half a Year
paras: 美國人力資源管理機構 ADP 周三 (5 日) 公布俗稱「小非農」的民間就業報告，7 月民間就業人數僅增加 4.4 萬人，創今年 1 月以來最小增幅，遠低於市場預期，顯示企業招聘動能有所降溫。
不過，轉職者薪資年增率加速至近一年最高，反映部分勞動市場依然緊俏，這項數據未必足以改變 Fed 對就業情勢的判斷，官員仍可將政策重心放在居高不下的通膨。
7 月民間就業人數低於 6 月下修後的 9.5 萬人，也不及《路透》調查經濟學家預估的 7 萬人。《彭博》調查中的所有預測同樣高於實際結果。Fed 上周維持利率不變，主席華許仍將勞動市場形容為「穩健」且「穩定」，但有三名官員因通膨疑慮主張升息。
觀察報告細項，教育與醫療服務業增加 3.6 萬人，繼續成為民間就業成長的主要來源；金融業增加 1 萬人，專業與商業服務業增加 9,000 人，其他服務業增加 6,000 人。休閒與餐旅業則減少 1.1 萬人，貿易、運輸與公用事業減少 8,000 人，天然資源與採礦業減少 6,000 人。
製造業就業人數僅增加 2,000 人，營建業也只增加 1,000 人。按企業規模區分，員工少於 50 人的小型企業增加 2.3 萬人，占整體增幅逾一半，顯示本月就業成長主要集中於小型企業及教育與醫療服務業。
儘管招聘速度放緩，薪資數據卻顯示部分勞動市場仍然緊俏。7 月留任者薪資年增率維持在 4.4%，轉職者薪資年增率則加速至 7%，創近一年來最大增幅，其中金融業與製造業的薪資成長尤其明顯。
ADP 首席經濟學家 Nela Richardson 表示，轉職者對即時經濟情勢高度敏感，其薪資快速上升意味部分勞動市場仍存在人力供給限制。她也指出，隨著企業因應不斷變化的總體經濟環境，過去常見的招聘模式正在改變。
這份報告顯示美國就業市場仍大致穩定，但新增就業動能已有放緩跡象。Fed 主席華許上周在決策會議後仍將勞動市場形容為「穩健」且「穩定」。由於就業尚未明顯惡化，若周五官方數據呈現類似趨勢，Fed 官員仍可將政策重心放在居高不下的通膨。Fed 上周維持利率不變，但有三名官員主張升息。
美國勞工統計局將於周五 (7 日) 公布 7 月非農就業報告，涵蓋民間與政府部門。市場預估整體非農就業人數增加 8 萬人，高於 6 月的 5.7 萬人，民間就業人數預估增加 7.8 萬人，失業率則料維持在 4.2%。
不過，ADP 數據與官方民間就業統計有時存在明顯落差，因此未必能準確預示周五的非農結果。世界大型企業聯合會近期調查也顯示，認為工作機會充足的美國消費者占比降至 2021 年 2 月以來最低，失業率仍存在小幅上升的風險。
paras_en: The US Labor Market Research Firm ADP released its monthly Small Business Jobs Report on Wednesday, showing that the number of private sector jobs increased by 44,000 in July, the smallest gain since January, and far below market expectations, indicating a slowdown in hiring momentum.

However, the average annual salary growth for job changers accelerated to its highest level in nearly a year, reflecting a still-tight labor market, which may not be enough to change the Fed's assessment of the labor market, and officials can still focus on the high inflation.

The 44,000 increase in private sector jobs was lower than the 95,000 downward revision in June and also below the 70,000 estimate by economists surveyed by Reuters. All predictions by Bloomberg also exceeded the actual result.

Fed officials maintained interest rates unchanged last week, with Chairman Jerome Powell still describing the labor market as "healthy" and "stable", but three officials advocated for a rate hike due to inflation concerns.

Breaking down the report, the education and healthcare services sector added 36,000 jobs, continuing to be the main driver of private sector job growth; the financial sector added 10,000 jobs, professional and business services added 9,000 jobs, and other services added 6,000 jobs.
However, the leisure and hospitality sector lost 11,000 jobs, trade, transportation, and public utilities lost 8,000 jobs, and the natural resources and mining sector lost 6,000 jobs.

Manufacturing jobs increased by only 2,000, and construction jobs increased by 1,000. By company size, small businesses with fewer than 50 employees added 23,000 jobs, accounting for more than half of the total increase, showing that job growth in this month was mainly concentrated in small businesses and education and healthcare services.

Despite the slowdown in hiring, salary data showed that some labor markets are still tight. The average annual salary growth for retained employees remained at 4.4%, while the average annual salary growth for job changers accelerated to 7%, the largest increase in nearly a year, with the financial sector and manufacturing sector showing particularly strong growth.

ADP Chief Economist Nela Richardson said that job changers are highly sensitive to the current economic situation, and their rapid salary growth indicates that some labor markets still have supply constraints. She also pointed out that as companies adapt to the changing overall economic environment, traditional hiring patterns are changing.

This report shows that the US labor market is still generally stable, but the hiring momentum has slowed. Fed Chairman Jerome Powell still described the labor market as "healthy" and "stable" after last week's decision-making meeting.

Since the labor market has not yet shown significant deterioration, if the official data released on Friday shows a similar trend, Fed officials can still focus on the high inflation. Fed officials maintained interest rates unchanged last week, but three officials advocated for a rate hike.

The US Bureau of Labor Statistics will release the July Non-Farm Payroll Report on Friday, covering both private and government sectors. Market expectations are for a total non-farm payroll increase of 800,000, higher than June's 570,000, with private sector jobs expected to increase by 780,000 and the unemployment rate expected to remain at 4.2%.

However, ADP data and official private sector employment statistics sometimes have significant discrepancies, so it may not be possible to accurately predict the non-farm results on Friday. A recent survey by the World Federation of Advertisers also showed that the percentage of US consumers who believe there are plenty of job opportunities has fallen to its lowest level since February 2021, and there is still a risk of a small increase in the unemployment rate.

items.title: 氣立2026年上半年轉盈稅後賺進4803萬元每股純益0.69元
items.title_en: LIT 2026 First Half Year Turned Profit After Tax of NT$48.03 Million Per Share, Net Profit of NT$0.69 Per Share
paras: 氣動與電控自動化元件廠氣立 (4555-TW) 今 (5) 日公布最新獲利，2026 年第二季稅後賺 4549 萬元，季增 16.91 倍，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.65 元， 上半年稅後賺進 4803 萬元，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.69 元。
氣立 2026 年第二季營收 4.92 億元，毛利率 32.95%，季增 2.82 個百分點，年增 0.87 個百分點，第二季稅後賺 4549 萬元，季增 16.91 倍，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.65 元。上半年稅後賺進 4803 萬元，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益爲 0.69 元。

氣立主管指出，以精密金屬製造為主的浙江平湖廠，受惠於 AI 興起所帶動 PCB 產業等生產設備需求增加，且機器人相關零組件訂單持續增長，加上歐洲客戶上半年度需求開始回溫，原有汽車與農機等業務亦維持平穩，使精密金屬製造業績始終維持相對高檔水準；而氣動及電控元件部分，由於台北廠與經銷商合力接獲半導體封測廠專案訂單、上海廠在大陸農業機械、液冷相關設備、新能源與儲能等業務開發有成下，整體營收也較去年同期提升；伴隨者泰國廠今年起正式投入貢獻集團營收；使上半年度營運增長。
氣立除了營收維持增長外，近年來積極推動的產品優化設計及產能重新配置計畫也見到成效，不但有效降低生產成本與提升效率外，更直接反映在毛利率上，從去年第二季起回升至 30% 以上，至今年第二季更近 33%。
在新產業及新產品開發上，氣立上半年在半導體封測專案訂單挹注與既有客戶持續下單下，相關無桿缸等產品出貨增長，半導體產業客群營收占比提升；至於超音波流量感測器部分，客戶驗證時間較原先預期長，但經過不斷測試與產品修正，從第二季末起也開始由原先測試訂單轉變為小額正式訂單，客群也由半導體廠務及 PCB 拓展至水資源，生技等產業，逐漸有效轉化為營收。
paras_en: LIT (4555-TW) announced its latest earnings today (5th), with a net profit of NT$45.49 million in the second quarter, a 16.91 times increase from the same period last year, with a net profit of NT$0.65 per share. The company's revenue for the first half of 2026 was NT$492 million, with a gross margin of 32.95%, a 2.82 percentage point increase from the same period last year, and a net profit of NT$48.03 million, a 16.91 times increase from the same period last year, with a net profit of NT$0.69 per share.

LIT's management pointed out that the company's precision metal manufacturing business in Zhejiang Pinghu, which is mainly focused on AI-driven PCB production equipment and machine-related component orders, has seen a significant increase in demand, and the company's European customers have started to see a rebound in demand in the first half of the year, while the company's existing automotive and agricultural machinery businesses have maintained a stable performance, resulting in a relatively high level of performance in the precision metal manufacturing industry.

In addition, the company's pneumatic and electrical control components business has seen a significant increase in revenue due to the joint efforts of the Taipei factory and distributors to receive semiconductor packaging factory project orders, and the Shanghai factory has seen significant growth in agricultural machinery, liquid cooling-related equipment, new energy, and energy storage businesses, resulting in a significant increase in revenue compared to the same period last year.
The company's Thai factory has officially started contributing to the group's revenue this year, resulting in a significant increase in revenue in the first half of the year.

In addition to revenue growth, the company's product optimization design and capacity reconfiguration plan, which has been actively promoted in recent years, has also seen significant results, not only effectively reducing production costs and improving efficiency, but also directly reflected in the gross margin, which has risen to over 30% since last year's second quarter, and reached 33% in the second quarter of this year.

In terms of new industries and new product development, LIT has seen significant growth in revenue from its semiconductor packaging project orders and existing customers' continued orders, with related products such as no-cylinder products seeing increased shipments, and the semiconductor industry customer group's revenue proportion increasing.

As for the ultrasonic flow sensor part, the customer verification time was longer than expected, but after continuous testing and product modification, it started to convert from testing orders to small formal orders from the end of the second quarter, and the customer group expanded from semiconductor factories and PCBs to water resources, biotechnology, and other industries, gradually converting into revenue.

items.title: 〈環宇法說〉光通訊市場持續供不應求 美禁中國光收發器有利後市營運
items.title_en: Universal Optoelectronics Says Optical Communications Market Remains Short of Supply; US Ban on Chinese Optical Transceivers Benefits Future Operations
paras: 環宇 - KY(4991-TW) 今 (5) 日舉行法說會，受惠於 AI 資料中心，帶動公司在光電晶圓代工與自有品牌光電元件 (AOC) 需求強勁，訂單能見度可看到今 (2026) 年年底，全年出貨展望樂觀。此外，針對傳聞美國川普即將禁止進口新型的中國製光收發器，環宇 - KY 總執行長兼總裁安寶信也指出，若能禁止中國進口，對於環宇 - KY 未來營運將有加分效果。
環宇 - KY 今日舉行線上法說會，也公告第 2 季財報，環宇 - KY 第 2 季營收為 7.7 億元、季增 7.8%、年增 57.2%；單季毛利率為 43.3%、季減 11.2 個百分比、年減 5.5 個百分比；稅後純益為 1.1 億元、季減 43.8%、年增達 672%，單季 EPS 為 0.92 元。
安寶信表示，展望第 3 季除營收持續成長外，也希望公司毛利率預估維持在 44%-48%，目前營業費用約介於 750 萬至 850 萬美元，在手訂單目前可看到年底，但受到磷化銦 (InP) 基板欠缺影響，連帶使產能受到限制，不過目前公司備料狀況觀察，到今年年底前沒有問題，明年會持續連繫其他國家供應商以解決原料問題。
會中也有法人提問，環宇 - KY 第 2 季毛利率掉到 43.3%、減少 12.2% 原因。安寶信表示，主要是產品組合變化及 AOC 的產量下降，第 2 季產品占比觀察，射頻晶圓代工約 23%，光電晶圓代工約 10%，AOC61%，其他 6%，上半年稅後純益為 3 億元，較去年同期由虧轉盈，上半年 EPS 為 2.58 元。
此外，針對外電報載，川普即將禁止中國製造的資料中心光收發模組進入美國，引發中國廠商中際旭創受影響。安寶信也對此回應，因環宇 - KY 生產地點就在美國，若美系客戶要向外採購下，對環宇 - KY 來說有望成為一大契機及後市營運。
paras_en: Universal Optoelectronics (KY) (4991‑TW) held its earnings briefing today (the 5th). Benefiting from AI data centers, the company sees strong demand for its photonic wafer foundry services and its own‑brand optoelectronic components (AOC), with order visibility extending to the end of 2026 and an optimistic full‑year shipment outlook. In response to rumors that the United States under President Trump will soon ban imports of new Chinese‑made optical transceivers, CEO and President An Baoxin noted that such a ban would be a plus for Universal’s future operations.

Universal conducted an online briefing today and also released its Q2 financial results. Q2 revenue was NT$770 million, up 7.8% quarter‑over‑quarter and 57.2% year‑over‑year. The quarterly gross margin was 43.3%, down 11.2 percentage points QoQ and 5.5 points YoY. Net profit after tax was NT$110 million, down 43.8% QoQ but up 672% YoY, with earnings per share of NT$0.92 for the quarter.

An said that for Q3, besides continued revenue growth, the company expects gross margins to stay in the 44%‑48% range. Operating expenses are currently about US$7.5‑8.5 million. Existing orders can be seen through year‑end, but a shortage of indium phosphide (InP) substrates is constraining capacity. However, the company’s material inventory looks sufficient through the end of this year, and it will keep contacting suppliers in other countries next year to resolve the raw‑material issue.

During the session, an institutional investor asked why Q2 gross margin fell to 43.3%, a 12.2‑point decline. An explained that the drop was mainly due to a shift in product mix and a reduction in AOC production. In Q2, product composition was roughly: RF wafer foundry 23%, photonic wafer foundry 10%, AOC 61%, and other 6%. For the first half of the year, net profit after tax was NT$300 million, turning a loss into a profit year‑over‑year, and H1 EPS was NT$2.58.

Regarding reports that the Trump administration will ban Chinese‑made data‑center optical transceiver modules from entering the United States, which could affect Chinese supplier Zhongji Xuchuang, An responded that Universal’s production sites are located in the U.S. If American customers need to source abroad, this could become a major opportunity for Universal’s future operations.

items.title: 2027科技預算1823億元史上最高 國科會：加碼AI算力、帶動中小微企業轉型AI化
items.title_en: Taiwan's 2027 Budget for Science and Technology Reaches NT$182.3 Billion, Highest in History
paras: 明 (2027) 年度中央總預算案已籌編完成，國科會主委吳誠文今 (5) 日表示，明年科技預算再創新高，達新台幣 1,823 億元，較今 (2026) 年成長約 9.47%，重點包括加碼投入主權 AI 算力與基礎建設，打造智慧國家 2.0，並藉由科技產業優勢帶動中小微企業轉型與 AI 化。
吳誠文表示，台灣雖然已經具有半導體與 AI 硬體產業的深厚實力，然而強敵環伺不能掉以輕心，必須持續不斷提升科技研發實力及國際競爭力。在全球地緣政治局勢與 AI 科技競合之際，台灣除了強化半導體與 AI 產業優勢以鞏固科技戰略地位及經濟繁榮之外，也正面臨產業結構轉型的關鍵階段，應該要藉科技產業優勢帶動社會各行各業繁榮。
吳誠文說明，雖然今 (2026) 年的中央總預算還在立法院討論，但行政院已經完成了明年總預算的規劃，明年科技預算將創新高來到 1,823 億元，相較於今年成長約 9.47%，其中最重要的是主權 AI 算力與基礎建設加碼投入，打造智慧國家 2.0，並藉科技產業優勢帶動中小微企業轉型與 AI 化，促進社會各行業全面繁榮。
吳誠文強調，明年行政院科技預算，首先要保障基礎學術研究穩定成長，並重點投入全球競逐的高效能運算、量子科技、智慧機器人、矽光子與光通訊、主權 AI 等「AI 新十大建設」關鍵科技及「五大信賴產業」關鍵科技。
吳誠文指出，例如：一、大南方新矽谷 84 億，加速建構南台灣 AI 產業生態系；二、 晶創台灣 207 億，落實「優勢延續、國際拓展、應用創新、永續調適」四大半導體政策支柱與產業技術布局；三、次世代通訊 4 億，掌握低軌通訊衛星產業發展契機，建構 6G 通訊產業優勢；四、智慧機器人 22 億，推動智慧機器人研發與產業生態系建構。
五、太空計畫三期 69 億，發展低軌通訊衛星與前瞻遙測衛星系統，建構國際太空產業合作契機；六、海洋科技方案 22 億，發展科技以推動海域安全科技化、海洋產業智慧化、海洋文化生活化；七、淨零科技 108 億，發展淨零與碳循環科技，推動實際場域驗證及社區實作以加速產業化；高齡科技 16 億元，推動高齡科技研發、應用服務系統開發、場域驗證、產業化等。
吳誠文指出，明年起行政院也將整合中央各部會能量推動「智慧國家 2.0」計畫，與地方政府合作把 AI 科技轉化為社會各行各業 AI 化的應用，進一步讓智慧化的中小微企業蓬勃發展，邁向全民智慧生活圈。
paras_en: The 2027 central government budget has been completed, and National Science Council (NSC) Chairman Wu Ching-wen announced on May 5 that the budget for science and technology will reach a new high of NT$182.3 billion, a 9.47% increase from last year. The focus will be on investing in sovereign AI computing power and infrastructure, creating a smart nation 2.0, and using technology industry advantages to drive the transformation and AI of small and medium-sized enterprises.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that although Taiwan has a deep foundation in semiconductor and AI hardware industries, it cannot be complacent with the strong competition surrounding it. It must continue to improve its technological research and development capabilities and international competitiveness. In the context of global geopolitics and AI technology competition, Taiwan not only needs to strengthen its semiconductor and AI industry advantages to consolidate its technological strategic position and economic prosperity, but also faces a critical stage of industrial structural transformation.

Wu Ching-wen explained that although the 2026 central government budget is still being discussed in the Legislative Yuan, the Executive Yuan has completed the planning for next year's budget. Next year's science and technology budget will reach a new high of NT$182.3 billion, a 9.47% increase from this year. The most important thing is to invest in sovereign AI computing power and infrastructure, create a smart nation 2.0, and use technology industry advantages to drive the transformation and AI of small and medium-sized enterprises, promoting the overall prosperity of various industries.

Wu Ching-wen emphasized that next year's Executive Yuan science and technology budget will first ensure the stable growth of basic academic research and focus on investing in key technologies such as high-performance computing, quantum technology, intelligent robots, silicon photonics and optical communication, and sovereign AI. The "AI New Ten Major Construction" and "Five Major Trust Industries" key technologies will also be prioritized.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that, for example, one is the South Taiwan AI Industry Ecosystem Construction Project, which will invest NT$84 billion to accelerate the construction of the AI industry ecosystem in southern Taiwan. Two is the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) project, which will invest NT$207 billion to implement the "Continuation of Advantage, International Expansion, Innovation, and Sustainable Adaptation" four-pillar semiconductor policy and industry technology layout.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that, for example, one is the Next-Generation Communication Project, which will invest NT$4 billion to grasp the opportunity of low-orbit communication satellite industry development, build a 6G communication industry advantage. Two is the Intelligent Robot Project, which will invest NT$22 billion to promote the development of intelligent robots and the construction of the robot industry ecosystem.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that, for example, one is the Space Plan Phase 3, which will invest NT$69 billion to develop low-orbit communication satellites and advanced remote sensing satellite systems, build international space industry cooperation opportunities. Two is the Ocean Technology Scheme, which will invest NT$22 billion to develop technology to promote ocean security, ocean industry intelligence, and ocean cultural living. Three is the Zero-Carbon Technology Project, which will invest NT$108 billion to develop zero-carbon and carbon cycle technologies, promote practical field verification and community implementation to accelerate industrialization.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that, for example, one is the Aging Technology Project, which will invest NT$16 billion to promote aging technology research and development, application service system development, field verification, and industrialization.

items.title: 氣立2026年上半年轉盈稅後賺進4803萬元每股純益0.69元
items.title_en: LIT 2026 First Half Year Turned Profit After Tax of NT$48.03 Million Per Share, Net Profit of NT$0.69 Per Share
paras: 氣動與電控自動化元件廠氣立 (4555-TW) 今 (5) 日公布最新獲利，2026 年第二季稅後賺 4549 萬元，季增 16.91 倍，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.65 元， 上半年稅後賺進 4803 萬元，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.69 元。
氣立 2026 年第二季營收 4.92 億元，毛利率 32.95%，季增 2.82 個百分點，年增 0.87 個百分點，第二季稅後賺 4549 萬元，季增 16.91 倍，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.65 元。上半年稅後賺進 4803 萬元，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益爲 0.69 元。

氣立主管指出，以精密金屬製造為主的浙江平湖廠，受惠於 AI 興起所帶動 PCB 產業等生產設備需求增加，且機器人相關零組件訂單持續增長，加上歐洲客戶上半年度需求開始回溫，原有汽車與農機等業務亦維持平穩，使精密金屬製造業績始終維持相對高檔水準；而氣動及電控元件部分，由於台北廠與經銷商合力接獲半導體封測廠專案訂單、上海廠在大陸農業機械、液冷相關設備、新能源與儲能等業務開發有成下，整體營收也較去年同期提升；伴隨者泰國廠今年起正式投入貢獻集團營收；使上半年度營運增長。
氣立除了營收維持增長外，近年來積極推動的產品優化設計及產能重新配置計畫也見到成效，不但有效降低生產成本與提升效率外，更直接反映在毛利率上，從去年第二季起回升至 30% 以上，至今年第二季更近 33%。
在新產業及新產品開發上，氣立上半年在半導體封測專案訂單挹注與既有客戶持續下單下，相關無桿缸等產品出貨增長，半導體產業客群營收占比提升；至於超音波流量感測器部分，客戶驗證時間較原先預期長，但經過不斷測試與產品修正，從第二季末起也開始由原先測試訂單轉變為小額正式訂單，客群也由半導體廠務及 PCB 拓展至水資源，生技等產業，逐漸有效轉化為營收。
paras_en: LIT (4555-TW) announced its latest earnings today (5th), with a net profit of NT$45.49 million in the second quarter, a 16.91 times increase from the same period last year, with a net profit of NT$0.65 per share. The company's revenue for the first half of 2026 was NT$492 million, with a gross margin of 32.95%, a 2.82 percentage point increase from the same period last year, and a net profit of NT$48.03 million, a 16.91 times increase from the same period last year, with a net profit of NT$0.69 per share.

LIT's management pointed out that the company's precision metal manufacturing business in Zhejiang Pinghu, which is mainly focused on AI-driven PCB production equipment and machine-related component orders, has seen a significant increase in demand, and the company's European customers have started to see a rebound in demand in the first half of the year, while the company's existing automotive and agricultural machinery businesses have maintained a stable performance, resulting in a relatively high level of performance in the precision metal manufacturing industry.

In addition, the company's pneumatic and electrical control components business has seen a significant increase in revenue due to the joint efforts of the Taipei factory and distributors to receive semiconductor packaging factory project orders, and the Shanghai factory has seen significant growth in agricultural machinery, liquid cooling-related equipment, new energy, and energy storage businesses, resulting in a significant increase in revenue compared to the same period last year.
The company's Thai factory has officially started contributing to the group's revenue this year, resulting in a significant increase in revenue in the first half of the year.

In addition to revenue growth, the company's product optimization design and capacity reconfiguration plan, which has been actively promoted in recent years, has also seen significant results, not only effectively reducing production costs and improving efficiency, but also directly reflected in the gross margin, which has risen to over 30% since last year's second quarter, and reached 33% in the second quarter of this year.

In terms of new industries and new product development, LIT has seen significant growth in revenue from its semiconductor packaging project orders and existing customers' continued orders, with related products such as no-cylinder products seeing increased shipments, and the semiconductor industry customer group's revenue proportion increasing.

As for the ultrasonic flow sensor part, the customer verification time was longer than expected, but after continuous testing and product modification, it started to convert from testing orders to small formal orders from the end of the second quarter, and the customer group expanded from semiconductor factories and PCBs to water resources, biotechnology, and other industries, gradually converting into revenue.

items.title: 驗32次全合格！台糖受波及自主下架估損2.43億元 喊告福懋求償
items.title_en: Passed All 32 Tests! Taiwan Sugar Sues Fu Mao for Estimated NT$243 Million Loss After Unfair Delisting
paras: 台糖今 (5) 日表示，針對今年 5 月向福懋（1225-TW）來自中聯的粗油，因中聯油品發生苯胼芘超標情事，連帶導致台糖商品無辜下架、商譽受損，保守估計光是沙拉油商品損失就高達 2.43 億元。台糖澄清，公司向來嚴格落實自主品管，今年以來沙拉油產品經主管機關及相關單位檢驗 32 次全部合格，部分民代與媒體稱其為毒油與事實不符。台糖目前正委請律師與會計師研商，將正式向福懋提告求償。
台糖指出，公司今年 5 月向福懋公司採購粗油，雖然均依據合約規範辦理規格檢驗，並將檢測結果與契約不符的粗油直接拒收，但福懋所提供來自中聯公司的油源，事後卻被驗出苯胼芘超標，進而引發市場疑慮與爭議。這項外購原料問題致使台糖產品遭受無妄之災，不僅面臨產品下架命運，更有形與無形地重創公司建立多年的商譽與品牌形象。
為了正視聽並維護權益，台糖重申公司對產品品質經營的堅持，強調從今年初至今，台糖沙拉油已累計接受各界抽驗多達 32 次，檢驗結果每次均安全過關，完全符合衛生標準。對於部分外界民代與媒體頻繁以毒油形容台糖產品，台糖對此表達遺憾與無奈，並呼籲外界勿再以訛傳訛，協助導正市場資訊。
針對後續法律行動與求償作業，台糖說明，內部目前已著手進行相關損失評估。初步保守估算，光是沙拉油產品下架與銷售停擺所產生的直接經濟損失，就至少達到 2.43 億元，至於商譽等無形損失金額則尚在精算評估中。台糖後續將儘快與律師及會計師進行研商，完成整體損失清算後，會正式向福懋公司提出告訴並爭取合法賠償。
paras_en: Taiwan Sugar announced today (May 5) that the crude oil it purchased in May from Fu Mao (1225‑TW), sourced from Zhonglian, was found to exceed the benzopyrene limit. This contamination forced Taiwan Sugar's products to be unjustly removed from shelves and damaged its goodwill, with a conservative estimate that losses from its salad oil alone total NT$243 million. Taiwan Sugar clarified that it has always strictly enforced independent quality control; since the start of the year its salad oil has been tested 32 times by regulators and related agencies, all passing, and it disputes claims by some legislators and media that the oil is poisonous.

The company noted that it purchased the crude oil from Fu Mao in May, conducting specification inspections as required by contract and rejecting any oil that did not meet the terms. However, the oil supplied by Fu Mao from Zhonglian was later found to contain excessive benzopyrene, sparking market concerns and controversy. This external raw‑material issue caused Taiwan Sugar’s products to suffer an unwarranted disaster, leading not only to product delisting but also to both tangible and intangible damage to the goodwill and brand image built over years.

To address the situation and protect its rights, Taiwan Sugar reiterated its commitment to product quality, emphasizing that since the beginning of the year its salad oil has undergone up to 32 random inspections, each passing safely and fully complying with health standards. The company expressed regret and helplessness over repeated references by some legislators and media to its products as "toxic oil," urging the public to stop spreading misinformation and help correct market information.

Regarding future legal action and compensation, Taiwan Sugar explained that it has begun internal loss assessments. A preliminary conservative estimate puts the direct economic loss from the salad oil’s delisting and sales suspension at at least NT$243 million, while intangible losses such as goodwill are still being precisely calculated. Taiwan Sugar will promptly consult with lawyers and accountants, and after finalizing the overall loss settlement, it will formally file a lawsuit against Fu Mao to seek lawful compensation.

items.title_en: 22 Overseas ETFs Hit New Highs, 00757 Surges 12% in a Week
paras: 美股昨日全面大漲，市場一面消化美伊談判進展，一面迎接密集企業財報。大型科技與半導體股成為今 (5) 日市場反彈的主要推力，更帶動在台掛牌的 22 檔海外股票 ETF 股價創新高。進一步統計這 22 檔 ETF 自 7/30 低點以來漲幅，統一 FANG+ ETF(00757-TW) 以雙位數的反彈幅度居冠。

根據 CMoney 統計，股市從 7/30 自低點強彈至今，已有 22 檔海外股票 ETF 領先大盤創高，其中，統一 FANG+ ETF(00757-TW) 以 12.35% 居榜單之冠，今 (5) 日股價收 141.95 元，再次改寫歷史新高。其餘則依序為國泰網路資安 (00875-TW)、大華美國 MAG7+(009815-TW)、華南永昌 NASDAQxT(009818-TW) 及復華 S&P500 成長 (00924-TW)。
​統一 FANG+ ETF 經理人林良一表示 7 月美股劇烈分化，主因在於科技巨頭財報遇賣壓、聯準會鷹派異議首現、油價反覆。月底微軟、亞馬遜雲端財報強勁，那指終結連六黑，蘋果財測疲弱走跌，AI 變現者與硬體落後者分歧擴大。
展望後市，林良一表示，資本支出逐步轉化為雲端營收，構成續強底氣；惟鷹派異議、殖利率高檔、油價震盪仍是變數。反彈品質取決財報能否延續 AI 變現力，領軍族群已收斂至 AI 基建巨頭。短線回檔可伺機布局，長線定期定額累積。

paras_en: US stocks surged yesterday, with the market digesting progress in US-Iran talks and receiving a slew of corporate earnings reports. Large-cap tech and semiconductor stocks drove the market's rebound today, also pushing the 22 overseas-listed stock ETFs to new highs. Further analysis shows that these 22 ETFs have risen by double-digit percentages since their low point on July 30.

According to CMoney statistics, the stock market has rebounded strongly from its low point on July 30, with 22 overseas stock ETFs leading the pack in reaching new highs. Among them, the Uni-FANG+ ETF (00757-TW) topped the list with a 12.35% rebound, closing at NT$141.95 yesterday and setting a new historical high.

items.title: 88萬家企業納入集體訴訟！Google恐面臨50億英鎊天價求償
items.title_en: 88 Million Businesses Eligible for Collective Lawsuit! Google Faces £5 Billion Compensation Claim
paras: Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下 Google 試圖阻止英國一宗搜尋廣告集體訴訟，但遭法院駁回。英國競爭上訴法庭 (Competition Appeal Tribunal) 周三 (5 日) 裁定，這起代表數十萬家英國企業提出的訴訟符合資格，得以進入後續審理程序。
訴訟指控 Google 利用其在行動作業系統、應用程式分發及搜尋廣告市場的主導地位，向購買網路廣告的企業收取過高費用，涉嫌濫用市場優勢。
擔任集體訴訟代表人的競爭法學者 Or Brook，其律師團隊估計，約有 88 萬家英國企業符合資格，求償金額最高可能達 50 億英鎊 (約 67 億美元)。
法庭在判決中表示，這項集體訴訟符合受理條件。符合資格的英國企業將自動被納入原告群體，除非主動選擇退出。這種「選擇退出制」意味受影響企業無須逐一登記，即可成為訴訟的一部分。
不過，法庭此次裁定僅代表案件可以繼續推進，之後仍須就 Google 是否違反競爭法及原告是否確實蒙受損失進行實體審理，並不代表 Google 已被認定違法。Google 發言人尚未回應置評要求。
paras_en: Alphabet's (GOOGL-US) Google has attempted to block a collective lawsuit in the UK over search advertising, but the court has rejected its bid. The UK Competition Appeal Tribunal (CAT) ruled on Wednesday (5th) that the lawsuit, which represents tens of thousands of UK businesses, is eligible to proceed to the next stage of the trial.

The lawsuit alleges that Google has abused its dominance in the mobile operating system, app distribution, and search advertising markets by charging excessive fees to businesses that purchase online ads.

Or Brook, a competition law expert representing the collective lawsuit, estimates that around 880,000 UK businesses are eligible to participate, with a potential compensation claim of up to £5 billion (approximately $6.7 billion).

The court ruled that the collective lawsuit meets the conditions for acceptance. Eligible UK businesses will automatically be included in the plaintiff group, unless they actively choose to opt out. This 'opt-out' mechanism means that affected businesses do not need to register individually to become part of the lawsuit.

However, the court's ruling only allows the case to proceed, and a full trial will still be needed to determine whether Google has breached competition law and whether the plaintiffs have suffered losses. Google has not yet responded to a request for comment.

items.title: 〈財報〉Uber上季業績無驚喜、本季展望平淡 盤前股價下挫
items.title_en: Uber's Q2 Earnings Disappoint, Q3 Outlook Unimpressive, Shares Fall
paras: Uber Technologies(UBER-US) 周三 (5 日) 於美股盤前公布 2026 會計年度第二季 (截至 6/30) 財報，受惠世界盃帶動叫車需求，總預訂金額優於華爾街預期，但營收僅大致符合預估，第三季 (本季) 獲利與預訂金額展望也未能帶來驚喜，加上巴西市場競爭升溫拖累行程量成長，盤前股價一度下跌約 3.5%。
截稿前，Uber(UBER-US) 周三盤前股價下跌 2.76%，每股暫報 70.00 美元。
Uber 第二季營收年增 12% 至 141.9 億美元，略低於 LSEG 統計分析師預估的 142.4 億美元；調整後每股盈餘為 0.81 美元，高於去年同期的 0.63 美元，也略優於 FactSet 預估的 0.80 美元。
衡量叫車與外送平台整體交易規模的總預訂金額年增 24% 至 580.2 億美元，高於華爾街預估的約 570.6 億至 572.3 億美元。Uber 表示，各地區及各項服務需求普遍增長，世界盃賽事相關旅遊活動尤其強勁，賽事期間有超過 800 萬名遊客在主辦城市使用 Uber。

世界盃需求撐業績 巴西競爭拖累行程量

Uber 第二季叫車與外送行程總量年增 18% 至 38.7 億趟，略低於分析師預估的 39 億趟。該公司表示，行程量增速放緩「完全可歸因於巴西」，該國是 Uber 全球交易量最大的市場，但近期競爭明顯加劇。
包括中國叫車平台滴滴全球 (Didi Global) 及外送巨頭美團在內的業者持續加碼巴西市場，競相爭取當地外送員及消費者，迫使 Uber 投入更多資源維持市占。公司第二季營業支出因此年增約 10%，行銷、研發及行政成本均有所增加。
不過，Uber 表示，過去一年新增的首次使用者人數，創下近五年任何同期最高紀錄。執行長 Dara Khosrowshahi 指出，新使用者持續增加，既有客戶的使用頻率也有所提升，公司正從穩健的業務基礎出發，擴大跨平台策略。
Uber 預估第三季總預訂金額介於 582.5 億至 602.5 億美元，中間值為 592.5 億美元，略低於華爾街預估的約 592.1 億至 593.3 億美元。公司預估調整後每股盈餘為 0.84 至 0.88 美元，中間值 0.86 美元，同樣低於 LSEG 統計的 0.89 美元預期。
Uber 警告，匯率因素預計將使第三季總預訂金額的年增率減少約 1 個百分點，扭轉過去四季匯率帶來的正面助益。由於核心業務展望僅大致符合預期，市場對 Uber 能否在自駕計程車時代維持成長的疑慮仍未消散。

砸逾百億美元押注 Robotaxi 倫敦服務仍配安全駕駛

Uber 重申，未來數年將投入超過 100 億美元發展自動駕駛車輛，但未公布具體投資時程。公司也在財報公布前宣布，將於未來數周與英國新創公司 Wayve Technologies 在倫敦推出 Robotaxi 服務，進度可望領先百度 (BIDU-US)(09888-HK) 與 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 旗下 Waymo 原定的當地部署計畫。
不過，Wayve 車輛初期仍會配置安全駕駛員，原因是雙方將先以一般私人出租車執照營運；若要提供真正無人駕駛服務，仍須取得額外監管批准。
Uber 去年密集宣布多項自駕車合作案，但管理層坦言，多數合作可能需要數年才能產生實質收益。與此同時，Waymo 正透過自有 App 將無人車服務擴展至更多美國城市，而非完全依賴 Uber 平台，也使部分投資人質疑 Uber 未來在 Robotaxi 產業鏈中的地位。
此外，Uber 上月宣布以 148 億美元收購 Delivery Hero，計畫以現有流動資金及舉債支付。大型收購案加上超過 100 億美元的自駕車投資承諾，使公司的資本配置成為市場關注焦點。Uber 股價在財報公布前今年已累計下跌約 12%，財報出爐後盤前跌幅一度擴大至 3.5%。
paras_en: Uber Technologies (UBER-US) reported its Q2 2026 earnings on Wednesday, benefiting from the World Cup's increased demand for ride-hailing services. Despite beating Wall Street's expectations for total bookings, revenue only met estimates, and the company's Q3 earnings and bookings outlook failed to impress. Additionally, the increasing competition in the Brazilian market, where Uber is the largest player, dragged down the growth in ride volume.
As of the deadline, Uber's (UBER-US) stock price fell 2.76% on Wednesday, trading at $70.00 per share.

Uber's Q2 revenue grew 12% year-over-year to $14.19 billion, slightly below the estimate of $14.24 billion from LSEG. Adjusted earnings per share were $0.81, higher than the $0.63 in the same period last year and slightly above FactSet's estimate of $0.80.

Total bookings, a measure of the company's overall transaction volume, grew 24% year-over-year to $58.02 billion, exceeding Wall Street's estimate of $57.06 billion to $57.23 billion. Uber stated that demand for its services was growing across regions and services, with World Cup-related travel activities being particularly strong, with over 8 million users in host cities using Uber during the event.
World Cup demand boosted earnings, but Brazilian competition hurt ride volume

Uber's Q2 ride volume grew 18% year-over-year to 3.87 billion trips, slightly below analysts' estimates of 3.9 billion trips. The company attributed the slowdown in growth to Brazil, which is Uber's largest market, but has seen increasing competition from companies like Didi Global (Didi Global) and Meituan (Meituan) in recent months.

Uber's operating expenses grew 10% year-over-year, with increased marketing, research and development, and administrative costs. However, the company stated that it had added a record number of new users in the past year, with CEO Dara Khosrowshahi saying that new users were continuing to increase, and existing users were using the service more frequently.

Uber forecast Q3 total bookings to be between $58.25 billion and $60.25 billion, with a midpoint of $59.25 billion, slightly below Wall Street's estimate of $59.21 billion to $59.33 billion. The company also forecast adjusted earnings per share to be between $0.84 and $0.88, with a midpoint of $0.86, slightly below LSEG's estimate of $0.89.

Uber warned that exchange rates would reduce its Q3 total bookings growth rate by about 1 percentage point, reversing the positive impact of exchange rates in the previous four quarters. The company's lackluster Q3 outlook has left investors concerned about its ability to maintain growth in the self-driving car era.

Uber reaffirmed its commitment to investing over $10 billion in autonomous vehicles over the next few years, but did not provide a specific timeline for its investments. The company also announced that it would be launching a Robotaxi service in London with Wayve Technologies, a UK-based startup, in the coming weeks, potentially ahead of Waymo's planned deployment in the city.

However, the initial Wayve vehicles will still be equipped with safety drivers, as the company plans to operate under a private hire license, and will need additional regulatory approvals to offer fully autonomous services.

Uber's management acknowledged that many of its self-driving partnerships may take years to generate tangible returns, while Waymo is expanding its autonomous services through its own app in more US cities, raising questions about Uber's role in the Robotaxi industry.

Uber also announced its plan to acquire Delivery Hero for $14.8 billion last month, which will be paid for with existing cash and debt. The large acquisition, combined with its over $10 billion commitment to self-driving cars, has raised concerns about the company's capital allocation. Uber's stock price has fallen about 12% this year, and fell as much as 3.5% after the earnings report.

items.title: 蘇姿丰再喊AI超級循環 AMD預估未來成長速度將高於市場
items.title_en: Lisa Su Calls AI a Super Cycle Again, AMD Forecasts Growth Faster Than Market
paras: 2026年08月05日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 超微AMD(AMD-US)於2026會計年度第二季法說會釋出更強勁的AI成長展望，不僅第二季營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於市場預期，管理層更同步上修AI運算市場規模、長期營收與獲利目標，並預估2027年資料中心業務營收將較2026年成長超過100%，反映AI基礎建設需求持續快速擴張。
AMD第二季營收達115.36億美元，年增率50%；非GAAP每股盈餘1.66美元，高於市場預估的1.61美元；資料中心業務營收達67億美元，年增率107%，占整體營收比重提升至58%，高於去年同期的42%，成為推動公司成長的核心動能。
執行長蘇姿丰（Lisa Su）表示，目前仍處於多年AI部署週期的初期階段，隨著各產業持續導入AI應用，對運算能力的需求持續攀升，公司產品組合與執行能力，將帶動未來數年營收與獲利持續擴大。
資料中心業務方面，EPYC伺服器處理器持續擴大市占率，雲端與企業客戶銷售皆年增超過70%，第五代EPYC Turin目前已支援全球超過1,600種公有雲執行個體中的近三分之一，並持續獲得AWS、Microsoft、Google、Oracle等大型雲端服務業者採用。AMD同時預告，第六代EPYC Venice已開始量產，預計今年稍晚開始部署，且客戶需求為歷代EPYC產品中最強。
AI加速器業務同樣展現強勁成長。AMD表示，MI355X需求持續擴大，新一代Helios機櫃式AI平台已投入生產，預計第三季開始出貨，第四季進一步放量，並延續至2027年。公司指出，Helios整合Venice處理器、MI450系列GPU、Pensando網路及ROCm軟體，可提供更高推論效能與更佳成本效益，目前客戶需求已高於原先預估。
法說會另一項重大宣布，是AMD新增Anthropic為大型AI合作夥伴。Anthropic將部署最高2 GW的MI450系列GPU，其中第一個1 Gigawatt預計於2027年上半年開始部署，雙方也將展開多年共同開發合作，加速ROCm軟體最佳化。此外，Microsoft也將於Azure平台大規模部署Helios，加入OpenAI與Meta之後，AMD主要AI客戶陣容進一步擴大。
隨著AI投資持續升溫，AMD同步調高市場規模預估。公司預期，2030年AI資料中心加速器市場將達約1.4兆美元，年複合成長率超過45%；伺服器CPU市場規模將達2200億美元，年複合成長率超過50%；整體高效能AI運算市場則將逼近2兆美元，未來數年維持約40%的年成長速度。
在更大的市場機會帶動下，AMD也提高自身成長目標。蘇姿丰表示，公司目前發展速度已明顯超越去年分析師日提出的長期財務模型，未來營收成長將大幅高於原先設定的35%以上目標，每股盈餘亦可望在策略期間內大幅超越每股20美元目標。
展望後市，AMD預估2026會計年度第三季營收約130億美元上下3億，以中值計算年增率約41%，主要來自資料中心與嵌入式業務持續維持雙位數成長；Client業務預估小幅成長，但Gaming業務仍將受到遊戲主機週期影響，維持雙位數衰退。
針對2027年展望，管理層於法說會中表示，Server CPU業務2026年下半年營收預估年增率超過80%，2027全年仍可望維持70%以上成長；資料中心AI業務則將因Helios平台持續放量而進一步加速，帶動整體資料中心部門2027年營收較2026年成長超過100%，成為公司下一波成長的主要引擎。

paras_en: On August 5, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) — AMD (AMD-US) presented a stronger AI growth outlook at its fiscal Q2 2026 earnings call. Not only did Q2 revenue and non‑GAAP earnings per share both beat market expectations, but management also raised its estimates for the AI compute market size, long‑term revenue and profit targets, and projected that data‑center revenue in 2027 would grow more than 100% versus 2026, reflecting the rapid expansion of AI infrastructure demand.

AMD reported Q2 revenue of $11.536 billion, up 50% year‑over‑year, and non‑GAAP EPS of $1.66, above the consensus estimate of $1.61. Data‑center revenue reached $6.7 billion, a 107% annual increase, accounting for 58% of total revenue versus 42% a year earlier, making it the core driver of the company’s growth.

CEO Lisa Su said the industry is still in the early phase of a multi‑year AI deployment cycle. As more sectors adopt AI applications, demand for compute power keeps climbing, and AMD’s product portfolio and execution capabilities will drive revenue and profit expansion over the next several years.

In the data‑center segment, EPYC server processors continue to gain market share, with cloud and enterprise sales both growing over 70% year‑over‑year. The fifth‑generation EPYC "Turin" now supports nearly one‑third of the more than 1,600 public‑cloud instance types worldwide and is being adopted by major cloud providers such as AWS, Microsoft, Google and Oracle. AMD also announced that the sixth‑generation EPYC "Venice" has entered volume production and will begin deployments later this year, with demand that is the strongest ever for an EPYC product line.

The AI accelerator business also showed robust growth. AMD said demand for the MI355X is expanding, and the next‑generation Helios rack‑mounted AI platform has entered production, with shipments slated to start in Q3 and volume ramp‑up in Q4, continuing into 2027. Helios integrates the Venice processor, MI450‑series GPUs, Pensando networking and ROCm software to deliver higher inference performance and better cost efficiency, and customer demand already exceeds original forecasts.

A major announcement at the call was the addition of Anthropic as a large‑AI partner. Anthropic will deploy up to 2 GW of MI450‑series GPUs, with the first 1‑GW deployment expected in the first half of 2027, and the two companies will embark on a multi‑year joint development effort to accelerate ROCm optimizations. Microsoft also plans a large‑scale Helios deployment on Azure, further expanding AMD’s roster of key AI customers after OpenAI and Meta.

With AI investment heating up, AMD raised its market size estimates. The company expects the AI data‑center accelerator market to reach roughly $1.4 trillion by 2030, a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of over 45%; the server CPU market to hit $220 billion, CAGR over 50%; and the overall high‑performance AI compute market to approach $2 trillion, maintaining about a 40% annual growth rate over the next few years.

Driven by the larger market opportunity, AMD lifted its own growth targets. Su said the company’s current pace already exceeds the long‑term financial model presented at last year’s analyst day, and revenue growth is expected to be well above the originally set 35%+ target, with EPS potentially surpassing the $20 per share goal during the strategic period.

Looking ahead, AMD forecasts FY2026 Q3 revenue of about $13 billion, give or take $300 million, implying a mid‑point year‑over‑year growth of roughly 41%, mainly from continued double‑digit growth in data‑center and embedded businesses; client revenue is expected to grow modestly, while gaming will remain in double‑digit decline due to the console cycle.

For the 2027 outlook, management said server‑CPU revenue in the second half of 2026 is projected to grow more than 80% year‑over‑year and that full‑year 2027 growth should stay above 70%. Data‑center AI revenue will accelerate further as the Helios platform scales, driving overall data‑center revenue in 2027 to grow more than 100% versus 2026, becoming the next major engine of AMD’s growth.

items.title: Fed還能只盯著通膨？美國7月小非農僅增4.4萬人 增幅創半年最低
items.title_en: US July Small Business Jobs Growth Slows to 44,000, Lowest in Half a Year
paras: 美國人力資源管理機構 ADP 周三 (5 日) 公布俗稱「小非農」的民間就業報告，7 月民間就業人數僅增加 4.4 萬人，創今年 1 月以來最小增幅，遠低於市場預期，顯示企業招聘動能有所降溫。
不過，轉職者薪資年增率加速至近一年最高，反映部分勞動市場依然緊俏，這項數據未必足以改變 Fed 對就業情勢的判斷，官員仍可將政策重心放在居高不下的通膨。
7 月民間就業人數低於 6 月下修後的 9.5 萬人，也不及《路透》調查經濟學家預估的 7 萬人。《彭博》調查中的所有預測同樣高於實際結果。Fed 上周維持利率不變，主席華許仍將勞動市場形容為「穩健」且「穩定」，但有三名官員因通膨疑慮主張升息。
觀察報告細項，教育與醫療服務業增加 3.6 萬人，繼續成為民間就業成長的主要來源；金融業增加 1 萬人，專業與商業服務業增加 9,000 人，其他服務業增加 6,000 人。休閒與餐旅業則減少 1.1 萬人，貿易、運輸與公用事業減少 8,000 人，天然資源與採礦業減少 6,000 人。
製造業就業人數僅增加 2,000 人，營建業也只增加 1,000 人。按企業規模區分，員工少於 50 人的小型企業增加 2.3 萬人，占整體增幅逾一半，顯示本月就業成長主要集中於小型企業及教育與醫療服務業。
儘管招聘速度放緩，薪資數據卻顯示部分勞動市場仍然緊俏。7 月留任者薪資年增率維持在 4.4%，轉職者薪資年增率則加速至 7%，創近一年來最大增幅，其中金融業與製造業的薪資成長尤其明顯。
ADP 首席經濟學家 Nela Richardson 表示，轉職者對即時經濟情勢高度敏感，其薪資快速上升意味部分勞動市場仍存在人力供給限制。她也指出，隨著企業因應不斷變化的總體經濟環境，過去常見的招聘模式正在改變。
這份報告顯示美國就業市場仍大致穩定，但新增就業動能已有放緩跡象。Fed 主席華許上周在決策會議後仍將勞動市場形容為「穩健」且「穩定」。由於就業尚未明顯惡化，若周五官方數據呈現類似趨勢，Fed 官員仍可將政策重心放在居高不下的通膨。Fed 上周維持利率不變，但有三名官員主張升息。
美國勞工統計局將於周五 (7 日) 公布 7 月非農就業報告，涵蓋民間與政府部門。市場預估整體非農就業人數增加 8 萬人，高於 6 月的 5.7 萬人，民間就業人數預估增加 7.8 萬人，失業率則料維持在 4.2%。
不過，ADP 數據與官方民間就業統計有時存在明顯落差，因此未必能準確預示周五的非農結果。世界大型企業聯合會近期調查也顯示，認為工作機會充足的美國消費者占比降至 2021 年 2 月以來最低，失業率仍存在小幅上升的風險。
paras_en: The US Labor Market Research Firm ADP released its monthly Small Business Jobs Report on Wednesday, showing that the number of private sector jobs increased by 44,000 in July, the smallest gain since January, and far below market expectations, indicating a slowdown in hiring momentum.

However, the average annual salary growth for job changers accelerated to its highest level in nearly a year, reflecting a still-tight labor market, which may not be enough to change the Fed's assessment of the labor market, and officials can still focus on the high inflation.

The 44,000 increase in private sector jobs was lower than the 95,000 downward revision in June and also below the 70,000 estimate by economists surveyed by Reuters. All predictions by Bloomberg also exceeded the actual result.

Fed officials maintained interest rates unchanged last week, with Chairman Jerome Powell still describing the labor market as "healthy" and "stable", but three officials advocated for a rate hike due to inflation concerns.

Breaking down the report, the education and healthcare services sector added 36,000 jobs, continuing to be the main driver of private sector job growth; the financial sector added 10,000 jobs, professional and business services added 9,000 jobs, and other services added 6,000 jobs.
However, the leisure and hospitality sector lost 11,000 jobs, trade, transportation, and public utilities lost 8,000 jobs, and the natural resources and mining sector lost 6,000 jobs.

Manufacturing jobs increased by only 2,000, and construction jobs increased by 1,000. By company size, small businesses with fewer than 50 employees added 23,000 jobs, accounting for more than half of the total increase, showing that job growth in this month was mainly concentrated in small businesses and education and healthcare services.

Despite the slowdown in hiring, salary data showed that some labor markets are still tight. The average annual salary growth for retained employees remained at 4.4%, while the average annual salary growth for job changers accelerated to 7%, the largest increase in nearly a year, with the financial sector and manufacturing sector showing particularly strong growth.

ADP Chief Economist Nela Richardson said that job changers are highly sensitive to the current economic situation, and their rapid salary growth indicates that some labor markets still have supply constraints. She also pointed out that as companies adapt to the changing overall economic environment, traditional hiring patterns are changing.

This report shows that the US labor market is still generally stable, but the hiring momentum has slowed. Fed Chairman Jerome Powell still described the labor market as "healthy" and "stable" after last week's decision-making meeting.

Since the labor market has not yet shown significant deterioration, if the official data released on Friday shows a similar trend, Fed officials can still focus on the high inflation. Fed officials maintained interest rates unchanged last week, but three officials advocated for a rate hike.

The US Bureau of Labor Statistics will release the July Non-Farm Payroll Report on Friday, covering both private and government sectors. Market expectations are for a total non-farm payroll increase of 800,000, higher than June's 570,000, with private sector jobs expected to increase by 780,000 and the unemployment rate expected to remain at 4.2%.

However, ADP data and official private sector employment statistics sometimes have significant discrepancies, so it may not be possible to accurately predict the non-farm results on Friday. A recent survey by the World Federation of Advertisers also showed that the percentage of US consumers who believe there are plenty of job opportunities has fallen to its lowest level since February 2021, and there is still a risk of a small increase in the unemployment rate.

items.title: 〈財報〉串流、主題樂園雙引擎發威！迪士尼上季獲利報喜
items.title_en: Disney's Q3 Earnings Beat Expectations, Driven by Toy Story 5 and Streaming Growth
paras: 迪士尼 (Walt Disney) 周三 (5 日) 美股盤前公布 2026 會計年度第三季 (截至 6 月 27 日) 財報，受惠《玩具總動員 5》(Toy Story 5) 票房熱賣、串流業務獲利改善及美國主題樂園需求強勁，調整後每股盈餘優於華爾街預期，帶動盤前股價大漲逾 4%。
截稿前，迪士尼 (DIS-US) 周三盤前股價上漲 3.89%，每股暫報 102.00 美元。
迪士尼第三季營收年增 7% 至 252 億美元，略低於 FactSet 與 LSEG 統計分析師預估的 254 億美元；調整後每股盈餘則年增 28% 至 2.06 美元，明顯高於市場預期的 1.86 美元。營業利益達 55.6 億美元，同樣優於《彭博》統計的 52.4 億美元預估，連續第二季交出超乎預期的獲利表現。
這也是達瑪羅 (Josh D’Amaro) 今年 3 月接替伊格 (Bob Iger) 出任執行長後公布的最新成績單。達瑪羅在致股東信中強調，公司將持續投資《玩具總動員》等核心 IP，讓熱門作品的影響力從電影院延伸至串流、消費性商品及主題樂園。

《玩具總動員 5》一魚多吃 串流獲利大增 64%

迪士尼娛樂事業第三季營收年增 6% 至 113 億美元，營業利益大增 64% 至近 17 億美元，主要受《玩具總動員 5》及《穿著 Prada 的惡魔 2》(The Devil Wears Prada 2) 票房成功，以及 Disney + 與 Hulu 訂閱費收入成長 15% 帶動。串流業務營業利益率更升至兩位數，顯示迪士尼多年投入線上影音後，獲利能力持續改善。
《玩具總動員 5》的效益也不只反映在票房上，電影同步帶動周邊商品銷售、Disney + 平台觀看熱度及主題樂園人流。不過，並非所有電影均有亮眼表現，《星際大戰：曼達洛人與古古》(Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu) 表現不佳，真人版《海洋奇緣》(Moana) 票房也低於預期，預料將拖累第四季娛樂部門業績。美國串流廣告市場疲弱，同樣可能形成壓力。
迪士尼同日另與 TikTok 達成合作協議，未來 TikTok 創作者可在短影音中使用迪士尼電影及電視作品的角色與片段，這也是 TikTok 首度與傳統媒體公司簽署此類授權協議。

樂園人潮不畏戰事 回購金額增至 90 億美元

包含主題樂園與郵輪業務的體驗事業第三季營收接近 100 億美元，年增 10%；營業利益增長 20% 至 30.2 億美元。全球樂園入園人次增加 4%，美國本土樂園人次則成長 3%，加州及佛州園區的遊客消費保持穩健，其中奧蘭多迪士尼世界表現尤其突出。
這項成績緩解市場對美伊戰事、油價上漲及消費信心轉弱可能衝擊旅遊需求的疑慮，也與競爭對手康卡斯特 (CMCSA-US) 旗下奧蘭多環球影城 6 月需求放緩形成對比。體驗事業獲利也包含約 1 億美元關稅退款。
體育事業第三季營收為 45 億美元，但受賽事轉播權利金支付時點及 NBA 季後賽前幾輪多次出現橫掃影響，營業利益年減 17% 至 8.58 億美元，低於華爾街預期。
迪士尼並確認，將以 12 億美元把 A+E Global Media 持股出售給合資夥伴赫斯特通訊 (Hearst Communications)，所得資金將用於買回股票，使 2026 會計年度庫藏股回購總額增至至少 90 億美元。
該公司預估第四季部門營業利益約 49 億美元，大致符合市場原先預期，並表示目前仍在推動裁員及削減行政支出等成本控制措施。
paras_en: Walt Disney Co. (DIS-US) reported a stronger-than-expected third-quarter earnings on Wednesday, driven by the success of Toy Story 5 and growth in its streaming business. The company's stock price surged over 4% in pre-market trading.

Disney's third-quarter revenue rose 7% to $25.2 billion, slightly below FactSet and LSEG analysts' estimates of $25.4 billion. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) rose 28% to $2.06, beating market expectations of $1.86. Operating income reached $5.56 billion, surpassing Bloomberg's estimate of $5.24 billion.

This is the latest quarterly performance under CEO Josh D'Amaro, who took over in March. D'Amaro emphasized in a letter to shareholders that the company will continue to invest in core IPs like Toy Story, extending the impact of popular films from theaters to streaming, consumer products, and theme parks.

Toy Story 5 was a major contributor to Disney's streaming growth, with revenue increasing 64% to nearly $1.7 billion. The film's success also drove growth in merchandise sales, Disney+ viewership, and theme park attendance.

However, not all films performed well. Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu underperformed, and the live-action Moana film underperformed expectations, which may impact fourth-quarter entertainment segment results. Weakness in the US streaming ad market may also pose a challenge.
Disney also announced a partnership with TikTok, allowing creators to use Disney characters and footage in short-form videos. This is TikTok's first such agreement with a traditional media company.

Theme park attendance remained strong, with a 4% increase in global attendance and a 3% increase in US domestic attendance. California and Florida park visitors maintained stable spending, with Orlando Disney World standing out.

This performance alleviates concerns about the impact of the US-Iran conflict, rising oil prices, and weakening consumer confidence on travel demand. It also contrasts with Comcast's (CMCSA-US) Orlando Universal Studios' 6% demand decline in June.

Experiential segment revenue reached nearly $10 billion, with a 10% year-over-year increase. Operating income grew 20% to $3.02 billion. Global park attendance increased 4%, with US domestic parks growing 3%.
The sports segment reported $4.5 billion in revenue, but operating income declined 17% to $858 million, below analyst expectations.

Disney confirmed plans to sell its 12% stake in A+E Global Media to partner Hearst Communications for $1.2 billion, using the proceeds to repurchase shares. The company's total share buyback amount for the 2026 fiscal year will increase to at least $9 billion.

Disney estimates fourth-quarter operating income of $4.9 billion, in line with market expectations. The company is still pushing forward with cost-cutting measures, including layoffs and administrative expense reductions.

items.title: AMD的財報成績史上最強 市場為何仍然不滿意？
items.title_en: AMD Posts Record Quarterly Results, Yet Stock Price Falls Over 8%
paras: 超微半導體 (AMD-US) 周二 (4 日) 公布 2026 年第二季財務報告，交出公司史上最強勁的季度營收表現。然而，即便營收與利潤均優於市場預期，AMD 股價在盤後交易中一度重挫超過 8%。

資料中心業務翻倍成長

根據財報數據，AMD 本季總營收達 115 億美元，較去年同期的 76.85 億美元大幅成長 50%，毛利率亦提升至 54%。
AMD 的增長動能主要來自資料中心業務。該部門第二季營收達到 67 億美元，年增率高達 107%，目前已占公司總收入的 58%。這項成長主要由 EPYC(霄龍) 伺服器處理器與 Instinct AI 加速器的大規模部署所帶動。
AMD 執行長蘇姿丰指出，AI 正在推動各個市場對運算需求的顯著擴張。她更樂觀預期，資料中心業務營收將在 2027 年再次翻倍，且 2026 年下半年的伺服器業務年增率將超過 80%。

除了單一晶片銷售，AMD 顯現出從硬體供應商轉型為整套 AI 基礎設施平台公司的趨勢。本季度推出的 Helios 是 AMD 首款整機櫃級 AI 系統，整合了 EPYC CPU、Instinct GPU、Pensando 網路晶片及 ROCm 軟體架構。此舉意在透過軟硬體協同，降低客戶對對手輝達 (Nvidia) 生態系的依賴，目前已獲 Meta、微軟、OpenAI 及 Anthropic 等科技巨頭採用。

市場反應冷淡

儘管財務數據亮眼，市場仍存在疑慮。股價受挫的主要原因之一在於馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 宣布其太空公司 SpaceX 將全面採用輝達的 Blackwell 架構晶片，並放棄原先採購 AMD 產品的計畫。馬斯克認為輝達的架構是目前市場上的「最佳選擇」。
此外，AMD 的資本支出 (CapEx) 顯著增加也引發投資人關注。本季資本支出由上一季的 3.89 億美元倍增至 8.08 億美元。Futurum Equities 首席市場策略師 Shay Boloor 分析指出，雖然高額支出可能在短期內影響投資情緒，但這是支撐 EPYC CPU 與 Helios 系統雙引擎增長、建立產能的必要投入。

市場期待與保守指引的落差 

針對市場反應，Futurum Group 執行長 Daniel Newman 評論認為，AMD 的財報表現其實相當穩健，但市場期待的是由 Helios 平台驅動的「爆炸性指引」，而 AMD 一貫採取相對保守的預測風格。
Moor Insights & Strategy 創辦人 Patrick Moorhead 則建議投資人保持耐心，因為 Helios 的出貨才剛開始，預計在第四季才會對營收有更明顯的貢獻。
展望 2026 年第三季，AMD 預期營收約為 130 億美元 (正負 3 億美元)，預計年增率約 41%。雖然 AMD 目前在 AI 訓練市場仍落後於輝達 (NVDA-US)，但隨著大型雲端服務商 (Hyperscalers) 積極尋求第二供應來源以增強供應鏈韌性，AMD 正透過大規模的系統部署合作 (如與 Anthropic 的吉瓦級合作) 穩固其市場地位。
paras_en: AMD (AMD-US) announced its second-quarter financial results on Tuesday, posting the company's strongest quarterly revenue performance in history. Despite beating market expectations for revenue and profit, AMD's stock price plummeted by over 8% in after-hours trading.

The company's datacenter business more than doubled in growth, with second-quarter revenue reaching $6.7 billion, a year-over-year increase of 107%. This growth was driven by the large-scale deployment of EPYC (EPYC) server processors and Instinct AI accelerators.

AMD CEO Dr. Lisa Su attributed the growth to the increasing demand for computing power driven by AI. She also expressed optimism that datacenter revenue will double again in 2027 and that server business revenue will exceed 80% in the second half of 2026.

In addition to single-chip sales, AMD is showing a trend of transitioning from a hardware supplier to a comprehensive AI infrastructure platform company. The company recently launched Helios, its first integrated AI system, which combines EPYC CPU, Instinct GPU, Pensando network chip, and ROCm software framework.

This move aims to reduce customers' dependence on rival NVIDIA's (NVDA-US) ecosystem through software and hardware collaboration. Helios has already been adopted by tech giants such as Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Anthropic.

Despite the strong financial data, the market remains skeptical. The stock price drop was partly due to Elon Musk's announcement that SpaceX will adopt NVIDIA's Blackwell architecture chip and abandon its plans to purchase AMD products. Musk considers NVIDIA's architecture to be the 'best choice' in the market.

AMD's capital expenditure (CapEx) has also raised concerns among investors, increasing from $389 million in the previous quarter to $808 million in the current quarter. Shay Boloor, chief market strategist at Futurum Equities, noted that while high CapEx may impact investor sentiment in the short term, it is necessary to support the growth of EPYC CPU and Helios system.

Futurum Group CEO Daniel Newman commented that AMD's financial performance is actually quite stable, but the market expects a 'explosive guidance' driven by the Helios platform, which AMD has consistently taken a conservative approach to forecasting.

Moor Insights & Strategy founder Patrick Moorhead advised investors to remain patient, as the shipment of Helios has just begun and is expected to contribute more significantly to revenue in the fourth quarter.

Looking ahead to the third quarter of 2026, AMD expects revenue to be around $13 billion (plus or minus $300 million), with a year-over-year growth rate of approximately 41%. Although AMD currently lags behind NVIDIA in the AI training market, the company is solidifying its market position through large-scale system deployment collaborations, such as its gigabyte-level collaboration with Anthropic.

items.title: AXT(AXTI-US)第二季業績超預期，背後透露這件事
items.title_en: AXT (AXTI-US) Surpasses Second-Quarter Expectations, Revealing a Hidden Fact
paras: 2026年08月05日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AXT(AXTI-US)公佈第二季財報，營收達4,760萬美元，較法人共識高出39.97%，也比公司原先於第一季提出的高信心基準多出約1,360萬美元，這其中隱含著非中光通訊供應鏈的上修機會。
本次超預期主要由於第二季出口許可的數量大幅增加所致，管理層在本季法說中表示，部分地區的出口許可流程已變得更有規律，取得速度也較先前加快，公司也正向中國商務部提出更多申請。
雖然個別訂單何時取得許可、最終能否獲准仍無法預測，但第二季結果顯示，新增許可所釋放的出貨，已經高於市場原先採用的保守基準。

過去曾經有這種情況嗎？
過去公司也曾受過出口管制之苦，在2023年8月同樣也是中國商務部針對砷化鎵進行出口管制，初期因出口申請流程與許可核發時間難以掌握，造成出貨遞延。
隨後在2023年9月取得首批砷化鎵許可並建立申請流程後，出口逐漸恢復，不過到了2024年情況開始好轉，雖然仍須要辦理出口申請，但已成為可以管理的日常營運程序。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)

為什麼市場如此關注AXT的出口許可情況？
根據優分析調查，目前AXT在全球磷化銦基板供應約佔35%，僅次於市占約40%的住友電工。兩家公司合計控制全球約四分之三供應，因為AXT的市佔率足夠大，因此出口核准速度會直接影響海外光通訊供應鏈的原料取得。
當許可審查流程較前幾季規律，海外客戶取得原料的可預測性便可能提高。
若部分磊晶或雷射晶片廠先前的生產確實受到基板短缺限制，原料供應改善後，便具備增加出貨的條件。
因此接下來真正要觀察的是客戶端，如美國的Coherent(COHR-US)、Lumentum(LITE-US)以及台灣的聯亞(3081-TW)等相關廠商是否開始提到基板交期縮短、原料到貨增加以及出貨動能進一步提高，若出口許可具有延續性，則有利於雷射光源相關廠商進一步得到上修的機會。
